raw.rationale: U-18666A is a late-stage cholesterol biosynthesis inhibitor (oxidosqualene cyclase/desmosterol reductase) that also disrupts NPC1-dependent cholesterol trafficking, causing broad, non-lineage-selective cytotoxicity at 2.5 µM over 5 days; PRISM-type screens show such cholesterol-pathway inhibitors rarely produce lineage-selective killing, with any apparent selectivity likely reflecting proliferation rate or transporter differences rather than lineage-specific dependencies.
